name: HellBounders
source:
A brief adventure through Hell and back.
Except we never actually get back.
And we don't get very far through Hell, either.

Created for [url=https://www.glorioustrainwrecks.com/node/2097]Pirate Kart V[/url].
translation:
穿越地狱并返回的短暂冒险。
但我们永远不会真正回来。
而且我们也没有走出地狱太远。

为 [url=https://www.glorioustrainwrecks.com/node/2097]Pirate Kart V[/url] 创建。
